actionConfirmation.title: Confirm sensitive action
actionConfirmation.body: This action can change or remove data. Your authentication provider handles sign-in; TeslaSync only asks you to confirm your intent.

externalAuth.title: Authentication and access
externalAuth.subtitle: Your authentication service owns browser sign-in, MFA and sessions.
externalAuth.native: This app uses a server access key. Browser authentication and provider sessions do not control that key.
externalAuth.open: Open mode: no browser authentication is configured. Restrict network access before exposing this installation.
externalAuth.unknown: The server authentication policy is not available yet.
externalAuth.noIdentity: No verified user identity was supplied for this request.
externalAuth.securityBody: Manage your password, second factors, recovery codes and signed-in devices in your authentication service. TeslaSync does not create passwords, enroll MFA, issue browser sessions or revoke provider sessions.
externalAuth.securityHelp: Open your authentication service directly to manage these settings. Its normal session policy applies; sensitive TeslaSync actions ask for confirmation, not another password.
externalAuth.accessBody: Everyone admitted by your browser authentication provider is a trusted operator with full application access. Limit who can enter at your proxy or authentication service; there is no separate TeslaSync role matrix.
externalAuth.connections: Personal preferences remain separate by verified identity. Native and automation access keys keep their own scopes. Tesla account authorization, share tokens, webhook credentials and operation safeguards remain independent.

changed.current: Manage second factors in your authentication provider, not inside TeslaSync.
changed.previous: Set up TOTP from your authenticator app to protect destructive admin actions.

changed.current: Your authentication provider owns recovery codes and account recovery.
changed.previous: Regenerate or download the backup codes used when you lose access to your authenticator.

changed.current: Change MFA policy and credentials in the external authentication service.
changed.previous: Remove the TOTP credential and revoke all backup codes for the current subject.

changed.current: View and revoke signed-in browser sessions in your authentication service.
changed.previous: See which browsers and devices are currently signed in to TeslaSync and revoke individual sessions.

changed.current: Use the external provider to sign out devices; TeslaSync does not issue browser sessions.
changed.previous: Revoke every TeslaSync session except the current browser. Useful after a lost laptop or shared computer.
